defect: generated clock is attributed to an independent clock with no physical path
rationale: sample_clk is the inverted sample_ref input. The generated declaration instead derives it from independent debug_ref, whose 40 ns period replaces the actual 6 ns clock timing and establishes a false clock relationship.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.note: The generated clock on sample_clk names debug_ref as its source, but sample_clk is the inversion of sample_ref, so the reading path is timed against the wrong 40 ns master.
